Sylvère Lotringer Papers and Semiotext(e) Archive

This series brings together the subject files kept by Sylvère Lotringer on various topics, artists, theorists and regions. Subject files have varied content, sometimes containing notes, photocopies, clippings, correspondence, manuscripts and/or photographs. They are arranged alphabetically by folder title.
